description: A single oscillator giving a sine, a triangle and a sawtooth at once, all three through one wavefolder

params.text: Sets the pitch, 0 giving C4 at 261.63Hz and one step an octave, so the travel runs 8.18Hz to 8372Hz; the tooltip reads that number as semitones and names a frequency the oscillator never reaches
Sets how hard all three waves are folded, from no folding at all to five times the gain into a reflecting fold
Shifts the pitch by a tenth of an octave either way, about 1.2 semitones
Scales the FM input into the pitch, nothing at the centre and an octave per 5V at either end, inverted anticlockwise

inputs.text: Adds to the pitch at one volt per octave
Adds to the FOLD knob, 10V covering the whole of that knob, and the total is held between no folding and full folding
Frequency modulation, scaled by the FM knob; with that knob hard over, 5V shifts the pitch one octave

outputs.text: A sine wave at ±5V, folded by the FOLD setting
A triangle wave at ±5V, folded by the FOLD setting
A sawtooth at ±5V, folded by the FOLD setting

notes: monophonic: only the first channel of any cable is read, and each output carries one channel

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.2:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
